name: Rain Transition
description: Dynamic weather scenario: dry start, rain onset at lap 15, full wet by lap 20, drying from lap 35. Educational model for exploring weather-driven strategy decisions.

provenance.notes: Authored scenario for weather strategy exploration. Not a meteorological prediction.

assumptionNotes.note: Weather timeline is a deterministic authored input, not a weather prediction. Transitions are linear interpolations at lap boundaries.

values.notes: Dynamic transition scenario for exploring tire compound and pit timing strategy under changing conditions
